frontier_selector.why: The evidence of a diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells uniformly positive for CD207/langerin and negative for myeloperoxidase decided it.

support_spans: A shave biopsy specimen demonstrated a diffuse atypical dermal infiltrate of monocytoid-appearing cells

BRAF-V600E variant status was identified through immunohistochemical studies
